title: Texnologiya va kundalik hayot
goal_uz: Dars oxirida texnologiya lug‘atidan foydalanasiz, qurilmalarning afzallik va kamchiliklarini muhokama qilasiz, narsa qanday ishlashini tushuntirasiz, kelajak texnologiyasi haqida bashorat qilasiz va yashay olmaydigan qurilmangiz haqida bir daqiqa gapira olasiz.

scenes.title: Texnologiya va kundalik hayot
board: devices · pros and cons · how it works · the future
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda ta’lim va o‘qish haqida gaplashdik, nimani afzal ko‘rishingizni aytishni mashq qildik. Bugun esa har kuni qo‘limizdagi narsa haqida: texnologiya. Qurilmalar va internet lug‘atini o‘rganamiz, texnologiyaning afzallik va kamchiliklarini muhokama qilamiz, biror narsa qanday ishlashini tushuntiramiz va kelajak haqida bashorat qilamiz. Dars oxirida o‘zingiz eng kerak deb bilgan qurilma haqida bir daqiqa gapira olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Last time we talked about education. Today we're talking about technology. You'll learn the words for devices, discuss good and bad points, explain how things work and make predictions about the future.
scenes.say_uz: Yana xush kelibsiz! O‘tgan safar ta’lim haqida gaplashdik. Bugun texnologiya haqida gaplashamiz. Qurilmalar so‘zlarini o‘rganasiz, yaxshi va yomon tomonlarini muhokama qilasiz, narsalar qanday ishlashini tushuntirasiz va kelajak haqida bashorat qilasiz.

scenes.title: Qurilmalar
board: smartphone (BrE also: mobile) · AmE: cell phone

examples.t: I use my laptop for work and my tablet for reading.
examples.uz: Ish uchun noutbukdan, o‘qish uchun planshetdan foydalanaman.

examples.t: My smartwatch counts my steps.
examples.uz: Aqlli soatim qadamlarimni sanaydi.

scenes.say_native: Avval qurilmalar. “Smartphone” — aqlli telefon. Britaniyada oddiy so‘zlashuvda “mobile” yoki “mobile phone” deyishadi, Amerikada esa “cell phone”. “Laptop” — noutbuk, “tablet” — planshet, “smartwatch” — aqlli soat. “Headphones” — quloqchin, “charger” — zaryadlovchi qurilma, “speaker” — dinamik.
scenes.say: Most people have a smartphone, and many also have a laptop or a tablet. I wear a smartwatch, and I never leave home without my headphones and charger.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘pchilik odamlarda smartfon bor, ko‘pchiligida esa noutbuk yoki planshet ham bor. Men aqlli soat taqaman va quloqchinlarim hamda zaryadlovchi qurilmamsiz uydan chiqmayman.

scenes.title: Internet va ilovalar
board: an app · a website · Wi-Fi · a password
download ↔ upload · log in ↔ log out

examples.t: I downloaded a new app yesterday.
examples.uz: Kecha yangi ilova yuklab oldim.

examples.t: You need a password to log in.
examples.uz: Kirish uchun parol kerak.

scenes.say_native: Endi internet lug‘ati. “App” — ilova, “website” — veb-sayt, “Wi-Fi” — simsiz tarmoq, “password” — parol. “Download” — internetdan yuklab olish, “upload” — o‘zingizdan internetga yuklash. “Log in” — tizimga kirish, “log out” — chiqish; Amerikada “sign in” ham keng tarqalgan. “Online” — internetga ulangan, “offline”
scenes.say: I download apps and upload photos. To log in, you need a password. If the Wi-Fi is down, you're offline, so you can't search for anything.
scenes.say_uz: Men ilovalarni yuklab olaman va suratlarni yuklayman. Kirish uchun parol kerak. Agar Wi-Fi ishlamasa, siz oflaynsiz, shuning uchun hech narsani qidira olmaysiz.

scenes.title: Qurilmalar bilan frazali fe’llar
board: turn on / turn off · switch on / switch off
plug in · charge · run out of battery
set up · back up · shut down · log in

examples.t: Turn it on and plug it in.
examples.uz: Uni yoqing va rozetkaga ulang.

examples.t: My phone ran out of battery.
examples.uz: Telefonimning batareyasi tugadi.

scenes.say_native: Qurilmalar bilan ko‘p frazali fe’l ishlatiladi. “Turn on” va “switch on” — yoqmoq, “turn off” va “switch off” — o‘chirmoq. “Plug in” — rozetkaga ulamoq. “Charge” — zaryadlamoq. “Run out of battery” — batareya tugab qolmoq. “Set up” — sozlamoq, “back up” — zaxira nusxa olmoq. Olmosh o‘rtada turishini eslang: “turn it on”, “plug it in”, “back them up”.
scenes.say: Plug in your phone and charge it. Turn it on, set up your account, and back up your photos. If your battery runs out, switch it off and wait.
scenes.say_uz: Telefoningizni ulang va zaryadlang. Uni yoqing, hisobingizni sozlang va suratlaringizdan zaxira nusxa oling. Batareya tugasa, uni o‘chiring va kuting.

scenes.title: Texnologiya lug‘atidagi xatolar
board: ✗ open the TV / open the light → ✓ turn on
✗ make a photo → ✓ take a photo
✗ a application → ✓ an application / an app
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato o‘zbekchadan keladi. Birinchisi: televizor yoki chiroqni “open” deyish. O‘zbekchada “ochmoq” deymiz, ingliz tilida esa “turn on” yoki “switch on”. “Open” faqat ilova yoki fayl uchun. Ikkinchisi: “make a photo”; to‘g‘risi “take a photo”. Uchinchisi: “download a application” emas, “an application”
scenes.say: We don't open the TV, we turn it on. We don't make a photo, we take a photo. And it's an app, not a app.
scenes.say_uz: Televizorni open qilmaymiz, uni turn on qilamiz. Suratni make qilmaymiz, take qilamiz. Va bu an app, a app emas.

scenes.title: Mos so‘zni tanlang
board: 3) ___ in your laptop. 4) ___ in with your password.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap, tepada esa to‘rtta fe’l: turn, take, plug va log. Har bir bo‘sh joyga mosini toping. Birinchisi televizor haqida, ikkinchisi surat haqida, uchinchisi noutbukni rozetkaga ulash haqida, to‘rtinchisi parol bilan kirish haqida. Har bir gapni to‘liq qilib baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Number one: what on the TV. Number two: what a photo. Number three: what in your laptop. Number four: what in with your password.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: televizorni nima qilasiz? Ikkinchi: suratni nima qilasiz? Uchinchi: noutbukingizni nima qilasiz? To‘rtinchi: parol bilan nima qilasiz?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “Turn on the TV”. Ikkinchi: “Take a photo”. Uchinchi: “Plug in your laptop”. To‘rtinchi: “Log in with your password”. Bularning hammasi buyruq shaklida, ya’ni fe’l gap boshida turibdi. Shu qoliplarni ko‘chirib, o‘zingizning gaplaringizni tuzing. Masalan: “Turn off your phone”
scenes.say: Turn on the TV. Take a photo. Plug in your laptop. Log in with your password.
scenes.say_uz: Televizorni yoqing. Suratga oling. Noutbukni ulang. Parol bilan kiring.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: technology va unga o‘xshashlar
scenes.say_native: Texnologiya so‘zlari ko‘pincha noto‘g‘ri urg‘u bilan aytiladi. “Technology” da urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: “tek-NOL-o-gee”. “-ology” bilan tugaydigan so‘zlarda urg‘u shu “ol” qismiga tushadi. “Electronic” da urg‘u “tron” da, “application” da “ca” da, chunki “-tion” dan oldingi bo‘g‘in. “Device”
scenes.say: Technology. Electronic. Application. Device. Battery. Listen to where the strong syllable is, and repeat after me.
scenes.say_uz: Technology. Electronic. Application. Device. Battery. Urg‘uli bo‘g‘in qayerdaligiga quloq soling va men bilan takrorlang.

scenes.title: Urg‘uni toping
scenes.say_native: Har bir so‘zni ikki marta baland ovozda ayting va urg‘uli bo‘g‘inni toping. Qoidalarni eslang: “-ology” da “ol” bo‘g‘ini, “-ic” dan oldingi bo‘g‘in, “-tion” dan oldingi bo‘g‘in, ikki bo‘g‘inli otlarda esa ko‘pincha birinchi bo‘g‘in. Keyingi sahnada to‘g‘ri variantni eshitasiz.
scenes.say: Technology. Electronic. Application. Battery. Say each word twice.
scenes.say_uz: Texnologiya. Elektron. Ilova. Batareya. Har bir so‘zni ikki marta ayting.

scenes.title: Urg‘u javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. “Technology” — ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: tekNOlogy. “Electronic” — uchinchi bo‘g‘in: elecTROnic. “Application” — to‘rtinchi bo‘g‘in: applicAtion. “Battery” — birinchi bo‘g‘in: BATtery. Urg‘uli bo‘g‘inni biroz uzunroq va balandroq ayting, qolgan bo‘g‘inlar esa qisqa va yengil bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: Technology. Electronic. Application. Battery. The strong syllable is longer and louder.
scenes.say_uz: Technology. Electronic. Application. Battery. Urg‘uli bo‘g‘in uzunroq va balandroq.

scenes.title: Afzalliklar
board: It allows us to + verb · It makes it easier to + verb
It's convenient · It keeps us connected

examples.t: Online banking saves me a lot of time.
examples.uz: Onlayn bank menga ko‘p vaqt tejaydi.

examples.t: Technology allows us to work from home.
examples.uz: Texnologiya uyda ishlashga imkon beradi.

scenes.say_native: Texnologiyaning afzalliklari haqida gapirish uchun tayyor iboralar kerak. “It saves time and money” — vaqt va pulni tejaydi. “It allows us to work from home” — uyda ishlashimizga imkon beradi; “allow” dan keyin odam va “to” bilan fe’l keladi. “It makes it easier to stay in touch” — aloqada bo‘lishni osonlashtiradi.
scenes.say: One big advantage is that technology saves us time. It allows us to work from home, and it makes it easier to stay in touch with family and friends.
scenes.say_uz: Katta afzalliklardan biri shuki, texnologiya vaqtimizni tejaydi. U uyda ishlashga imkon beradi va oila hamda do‘stlar bilan aloqada bo‘lishni osonlashtiradi.

scenes.title: Kamchiliklar
board: depend on · waste time · lose focus
privacy · screen time · be distracted by

examples.t: Many teenagers are addicted to their phones.
examples.uz: Ko‘p o‘smirlar telefonga qaram.

examples.t: I get distracted by notifications.
examples.uz: Bildirishnomalar meni chalg‘itadi.

scenes.say_native: Endi kamchiliklar. “Be addicted to” — biror narsaga qaram bo‘lmoq, “to” dan keyin ot yoki “-ing”: “addicted to scrolling”. “Depend on” — bog‘liq bo‘lmoq, “of” emas, “on”. “Be distracted by” — chalg‘imoq. “Screen time” — ekran oldida o‘tkazilgan vaqt. “Privacy” — shaxsiy hayot daxlsizligi. “Waste time”
scenes.say: The main disadvantage is that people depend on their phones too much. Some are even addicted to social media, and notifications distract us from work. Too much screen time is also bad for our sleep.
scenes.say_uz: Asosiy kamchilik shuki, odamlar telefonlariga juda bog‘lanib qolgan. Ba’zilari hatto ijtimoiy tarmoqlarga qaram, bildirishnomalar esa bizni ishdan chalg‘itadi. Ekran oldida haddan tashqari ko‘p vaqt o‘tkazish uyquga ham zarar.

scenes.title: Fikrni muvozanatli aytish
board: On the one hand, … On the other hand, …

examples.t: On the one hand, it's fast. On the other hand, it's expensive.
examples.uz: Bir tomondan, u tez. Boshqa tomondan, qimmat.

examples.t: Although it's useful, it can be distracting.
examples.uz: U foydali bo‘lsa-da, chalg‘itishi mumkin.

scenes.say_native: Yaxshi nutq ikkala tomonni ko‘rsatadi. “On the one hand… on the other hand…” — bir tomondan, boshqa tomondan. “However” — biroq; u gapni boshlaydi, ketidan vergul keladi. “Although” — “…bo‘lsa-da”, va u bilan “but” ni birga ishlatmaymiz: “Although it’s useful, it’s distracting”, “but” kerak emas.
scenes.say: On the one hand, smartphones are very useful. On the other hand, they can be distracting. However, I think the advantages are bigger than the disadvantages.
scenes.say_uz: Bir tomondan, smartfonlar juda foydali. Boshqa tomondan, ular chalg‘itishi mumkin. Biroq menimcha, afzalliklari kamchiliklaridan kattaroq.

scenes.title: Predlog va bog‘lovchi xatolari
board: ✗ Although it's good, but … → ✓ Although it's good, …
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: “depend of”. O‘zbekcha “ga bog‘liq” ta’siridan “of” deymiz, to‘g‘risi “depend on”. Ikkinchisi: “addicted of”; kerakli predlog “to”. Uchinchisi: “Although it’s good, but…” — o‘zbekchada “garchi… lekin” deyish mumkin, ingliz tilida esa “although” va “but” bir gapda ishlatilmaydi.
scenes.say: Remember: depend on, addicted to. And use although or but, not both. Although it's useful, it's expensive.
scenes.say_uz: Eslang: depend on, addicted to. Although yoki but ishlating, ikkalasini emas. Garchi foydali bo‘lsa-da, qimmat.

scenes.title: Gapni tugating
board: 3) ___ it's cheap, it isn't very good.
4) On the one hand it's fast; ___ the other hand it's loud.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapdagi bo‘sh joyni to‘ldiring. Birinchi gapda bog‘liqlik haqida, ikkinchisida qaramlik haqida gap ketyapti, ikkalasida predlog kerak. Uchinchi gap qarama-qarshilik bildiradi va uning ichida “but” yo‘q. To‘rtinchi gapda “bir tomondan, boshqa tomondan” qolipining ikkinchi yarmi yetishmaydi. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Number one: many people depend what their phones? Number two: she is addicted what online games? Number three: what it's cheap, it isn't very good? Number four: on the one hand it's fast; what the other hand it's loud?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: ko‘p odamlar telefonlariga nima qiladi? Ikkinchi: u onlayn o‘yinlarga nima? Uchinchi: nima arzon bo‘lsa-da, u unchalik yaxshi emas? To‘rtinchi: bir tomondan u tez; boshqa tomondan u shovqinli.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “depend on”. Ikkinchi: “addicted to”. Uchinchi: “Although it’s cheap, it isn’t very good”, bu yerda “but” kerak emas. To‘rtinchi: “on the other hand”, ya’ni “on” predlogi. Agar ikkinchi javobda “of” desangiz, bu o‘zbek tilidagi “ga” qo‘shimchasining ta’siri; “addicted” bilan “to”
scenes.say: One: on. Two: to. Three: Although. Four: on. Although it's cheap, it isn't very good.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: on. Ikki: to. Uch: Although. To‘rt: on. Garchi arzon bo‘lsa-da, u unchalik yaxshi emas.

scenes.title: Tinglash: telefonsiz yashash
board: Why does Ben like his phone?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Ben bilan Mia telefonlar haqida bahslashmoqda. Ben telefonsiz yashay olmasligini aytadi, Mia esa boshqacha fikrda. Tinglaganda uch narsaga e’tibor bering: Ben telefonda nimalarni qiladi, Miyaning qanday muammosi bor va Ben qanday maslahat beradi. Dialogda “on the one hand” va “however” kabi ibora ham eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Ben: I can't live without my phone. Mia: Really? I think we spend too much time on them. Ben: On the one hand, you're right. On the other hand, it saves me so much time. I pay bills and check bus times on it. Mia: However, I'm addicted to social media and I can't sleep. Ben: Why don't you turn it off at night? Mia: Good idea!
scenes.say_uz: Ben: Men telefonsiz yashay olmayman. Mia: Haqiqatanmi? Menimcha, biz ularga juda ko‘p vaqt sarflaymiz. Ben: Bir tomondan, siz haqsiz. Boshqa tomondan, u menga juda ko‘p vaqt tejaydi. Men undan hisoblarni to‘layman va avtobus vaqtlarini tekshiraman. Mia: Biroq men ijtimoiy tarmoqlarga qaramman va uxlay olmayman. Ben: Nega uni kechasi o‘chirib qo‘ymaysiz? Mia: Yaxshi fikr!

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) Why does Ben like his phone?
scenes.say_native: Dialogni eslab uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: Ben telefonini nega yaxshi ko‘radi va u bilan nimalar qiladi? Ikkinchi: Miyaning qanday muammosi bor? Uchinchi: Ben qanday maslahat beradi? Javobni to‘liq gap bilan bering, masalan “Ben likes his phone because…” deb boshlang.
scenes.say: Why does Ben like his phone? What problem does Mia have? What does Ben suggest?
scenes.say_uz: Ben nega telefonini yoqtiradi? Miyaning qanday muammosi bor? Ben nimani taklif qiladi?

scenes.title: Dialog javoblari
board: 1) It saves him time (bills, bus times).
2) She's addicted to social media and can't sleep.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: telefon unga vaqt tejaydi, u hisoblarni to‘laydi va avtobus vaqtini tekshiradi. Ikkinchi: Mia ijtimoiy tarmoqlarga qaram va yaxshi uxlay olmaydi. Uchinchi: Ben telefonni kechasi o‘chirishni maslahat beradi, “Why don’t you turn it off at night?” orqali. Bu yerda “turn it off”
scenes.say: Ben likes his phone because it saves him time. Mia is addicted to social media and can't sleep. Ben suggests turning it off at night.
scenes.say_uz: Ben telefonini yoqtiradi, chunki u unga vaqt tejaydi. Mia ijtimoiy tarmoqlarga qaram va uxlay olmaydi. Ben uni kechasi o‘chirishni taklif qiladi.

scenes.title: Narsa qanday ishlashini tushuntirish
board: It's used for + -ing · It's used to + verb

examples.t: It works by connecting to the Wi-Fi.
examples.uz: U Wi-Fi ga ulanish orqali ishlaydi.

examples.t: A kettle is used for boiling water.
examples.uz: Choynak suvni qaynatish uchun ishlatiladi.

scenes.say_native: Endi biror narsa qanday ishlashini tushuntirish. Umumiy haqiqatlar uchun hozirgi oddiy zamon ishlatiladi: “You press the button and the screen turns on”. Ishlash usuli — “It works by” va “-ing”: “by connecting”. Maqsad — “It’s used for” va “-ing”, yoki “It’s used to” va oddiy fe’l: “It’s used to boil water”.
scenes.say: A smart speaker works by listening for your voice. It's used for playing music and answering questions. You just say a command, and it does the rest.
scenes.say_uz: Aqlli dinamik ovozingizni tinglash orqali ishlaydi. U musiqa qo‘yish va savollarga javob berish uchun ishlatiladi. Siz shunchaki buyruq aytasiz, qolganini u qiladi.

scenes.title: Tartib so‘zlari va nomini bilmaganda
board: First, … Then … Next, … After that, … Finally, …
It's a thing that / which you use to + verb

examples.t: First, press the button. Then wait for the light.
examples.uz: Avval tugmani bosing. Keyin chiroqni kuting.

examples.t: It's a device that you use to charge your phone.
examples.uz: Bu telefonni zaryadlash uchun ishlatadigan qurilma.

scenes.say_native: Jarayonni tartib bilan aytish uchun “first”, “then”, “next”, “after that” va “finally” so‘zlarini ishlatamiz. Agar kerakli so‘zni bilmasangiz, uni tasvirlab bering: “It’s a thing that you use to charge your phone”. Narsalar uchun “that” yoki “which” ishlatiladi, “who” faqat odamlar uchun. Yana: “It’s like a phone, but bigger”.
scenes.say: First, press the button. Then wait for the light. Next, choose your language. After that, connect to the Wi-Fi. Finally, log in. I forgot the word! It's a thing that you use to charge your phone.
scenes.say_uz: Avval tugmani bosing. Keyin chiroqni kuting. Keyin tilni tanlang. Shundan so‘ng Wi-Fi ga ulaning. Oxirida tizimga kiring. So‘zni unutibman! Bu telefonni zaryadlash uchun ishlatadigan narsa.

scenes.title: Ishlash va tasvirlashdagi xatolar
board: ✗ It serves for taking photos → ✓ It's used for taking photos
✗ It works with pressing → ✓ by pressing
✗ a thing who … → ✓ a thing that / which …
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: “It serves for…”. Bu ruscha “служит для” ning so‘zma-so‘z tarjimasi; ingliz tilida “It’s used for taking photos” deymiz. Ikkinchisi: usulni bildirishda “with” ishlatish, to‘g‘risi “by” va “-ing”: “by pressing”. Uchinchisi: narsalar uchun “who” ishlatish. “Who” faqat odamlarga, narsalarga esa “that”
scenes.say: Don't say it serves for. Say it's used for taking photos. It works by pressing a button. And it's a thing that you use, not a thing who.
scenes.say_uz: It serves for demang. It's used for taking photos deng. U tugmani bosish orqali ishlaydi. Va bu thing that, thing who emas.

scenes.title: Tushuntirib bering
board: 2) A power bank → a thing that …
scenes.say_native: Uchta narsani tushuntiring. Birinchi: kir yuvish mashinasi nima uchun ishlatiladi? “It’s used for washing clothes” kabi gap tuzing. Ikkinchi: powerbank nomini bilmagandek, “a thing that…” bilan tasvirlang. Uchinchi: smartfon kamerasi qanday ishlaydi, “by” bilan aytib ko‘ring. Har bir gapni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Explain a washing machine with used for. Describe a power bank with a thing that. Explain a phone camera with works by.
scenes.say_uz: Kir yuvish mashinasini used for bilan tushuntiring. Powerbankni a thing that bilan tasvirlang. Telefon kamerasini works by bilan tushuntiring.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javoblar
board: 2) It's a thing that you use to charge your phone.
3) It works by taking light through a lens.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi: “A washing machine is used for washing clothes”. Ikkinchi: “A power bank is a thing that you use to charge your phone when there’s no socket”. Uchinchi: “A phone camera works by taking light through a lens”. Sizning javobingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi qoliplar to‘g‘ri bo‘lsin: “used for”
scenes.say: A washing machine is used for washing clothes. A power bank is a thing that you use to charge your phone. A phone camera works by taking light through a lens.
scenes.say_uz: Kir yuvish mashinasi kiyim yuvish uchun ishlatiladi. Powerbank telefoningizni zaryadlash uchun ishlatadigan narsa. Telefon kamerasi yorug‘likni linza orqali olish yo‘li bilan ishlaydi.

scenes.title: Tinglash: yordam xizmati
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Mijoz yordam xizmatiga qo‘ng‘iroq qilmoqda: noutbuki yonmayapti. Xodim savol berib, uni bosqichma-bosqich yo‘naltiradi. Tinglang: muammo nima, xodim birinchi nimani so‘raydi va ayol nima qilishi kerak. Dialogda tartib so‘zlari va frazali fe’llar bor, ularni ushlashga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: Agent: Hello, how can I help? Customer: My laptop won't turn on. Agent: First, is it plugged in? Customer: Yes, and I've charged it for an hour. Agent: OK. Hold the power button for ten seconds, then let go. After that, press it once. Customer: Oh, it's starting! Thank you.
scenes.say_uz: Xodim: Salom, qanday yordam bera olaman? Mijoz: Noutbukim yonmayapti. Xodim: Avval, u rozetkaga ulanganmi? Mijoz: Ha, va uni bir soat zaryadlaganman. Xodim: Yaxshi. Quvvat tugmasini o‘n soniya bosib turing, keyin qo‘yib yuboring. Shundan so‘ng uni bir marta bosing. Mijoz: Voy, yoqilyapti! Rahmat.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 2) What does the agent ask first?
3) What must she do with the power button?
scenes.say_native: Dialogni eslab, uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: mijozning muammosi nima? Ikkinchi: xodim birinchi nimani so‘raydi? Uchinchi: quvvat tugmasi bilan nima qilish kerak? Bu yerda vaqt va ketma-ketlikni ham aytib bering. To‘liq gap bilan ayting. Masalan, “Her laptop won’t turn on” deb boshlash mumkin.
scenes.say: What's the problem? What does the agent ask first? What must she do with the power button?
scenes.say_uz: Muammo nima? Xodim birinchi nimani so‘raydi? Quvvat tugmasi bilan nima qilishi kerak?

scenes.title: Dialog javoblari: yordam xizmati
board: 3) Hold it for ten seconds, let go, press once.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: noutbuk yonmayapti, “won’t turn on”. Bu yerda “won’t” — “yonishni xohlamayapti”, ya’ni qurilma talabga javob bermayapti. Ikkinchi: xodim avval “Is it plugged in?” deb so‘raydi, ya’ni rozetkaga ulanganmi. Uchinchi: tugmani o‘n soniya bosib turish, qo‘yib yuborish va bir marta bosish.
scenes.say: Her laptop won't turn on. The agent asks first if it's plugged in. She must hold the button for ten seconds, let go, and then press it once.
scenes.say_uz: Uning noutbuki yonmayapti. Xodim avval u ulanganmi, deb so‘raydi. U tugmani o‘n soniya bosib turishi, qo‘yib yuborishi va keyin bir marta bosishi kerak.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: bog‘lanib aytish
board: plug it in · log in · back it up
scenes.say_native: Tabiiy nutqda frazali fe’l va olmosh bir-biriga bog‘lanib aytiladi. Agar so‘z undosh bilan tugab, keyingisi unli bilan boshlansa, ular birga eshitiladi. “Turn it on” — “tur-ni-ton”, “plug it in” — “plug-ge-tin”, “log in” — “lo-gin”. Har bir so‘zni alohida, to‘xtab aytsangiz, nutq sun’iy chiqadi.
scenes.say: Turn it on. Plug it in. Log in. Back it up. Check it out. Say them smoothly, without stopping between the words.
scenes.say_uz: Turn it on. Plug it in. Log in. Back it up. Check it out. Ularni so‘zlar orasida to‘xtamasdan, silliq ayting.

scenes.title: Artikl: the internet, a laptop, TV
board: the internet · on the phone · a laptop / an app
watch TV (no article) · on the TV (screen)

examples.t: Technology is changing fast.
examples.uz: Texnologiya tez o‘zgaryapti.

examples.t: I spend hours on social media.
examples.uz: Men ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda soatlab vaqt o‘tkazaman.

scenes.say_native: Texnologiya mavzusida artikl ko‘p xato keltiradi. Yagona narsa uchun “the”: “the internet”. Qurilmaning bittasi haqida birinchi marta gapirsak “a”: “a laptop”, “an app”. Umumiy tushunchalar artiklsiz: “Technology is changing fast”, “social media”. “Watch TV” artiklsiz, lekin ekranning o‘zi haqida “on the TV”.
scenes.say: I use the internet every day. I bought a laptop and an app for it. Technology is changing fast, and I spend a lot of time on social media. I often watch TV, and I talk on the phone every evening.
scenes.say_uz: Men internetdan har kuni foydalanaman. Men noutbuk va unga ilova sotib oldim. Texnologiya tez o‘zgaryapti va men ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda ko‘p vaqt o‘tkazaman. Men tez-tez televizor ko‘raman va har kech telefonda gaplashaman.

scenes.title: Xavfsizlik va maslahat
board: a scam · a suspicious link · privacy

examples.t: You should use a different password for each account.
examples.uz: Har bir hisob uchun alohida parol ishlatishingiz kerak.

examples.t: Don't click on suspicious links.
examples.uz: Shubhali havolalarni bosmang.

scenes.say_native: Texnologiyadan foydalanishda xavfsizlik ham muhim. “A strong password” — kuchli parol, “two-step verification” — ikki bosqichli tasdiqlash. “A scam” — firibgarlik, “a suspicious link” — shubhali havola. “Privacy” — shaxsiy ma’lumotlar daxlsizligi. Maslahat berish uchun “should” va “shouldn’t”
scenes.say: You should use a strong password and turn on two-step verification. Don't click on suspicious links, because they might be a scam. Keep your personal data private.
scenes.say_uz: Kuchli parol ishlatishingiz va ikki bosqichli tasdiqlashni yoqishingiz kerak. Shubhali havolalarni bosmang, chunki ular firibgarlik bo‘lishi mumkin. Shaxsiy ma’lumotlaringizni maxfiy saqlang.

scenes.title: Kelajak: will va going to
board: will + verb: bashorat, fikr (I think it will …)
be going to: dalil bor (Look at those clouds!)

examples.t: I think robots will do more housework.
examples.uz: Menimcha, robotlar uy ishlarini ko‘proq bajaradi.

examples.t: Prices are going down, so more people are going to buy electric cars.
examples.uz: Narxlar tushyapti, shuning uchun ko‘proq odamlar elektr avtomobil sotib oladi.

scenes.say_native: Endi kelajak haqida. Fikr yoki taxmin bildirsak, “will”: “I think robots will do more housework”. Hozirgi dalilga asoslangan bashorat uchun “be going to”: “Prices are going down, so more people are going to buy electric cars”. Ishonch darajasini “definitely” — albatta, “probably” — ehtimol bilan oshiring yoki kamaytiring.
scenes.say: I think robots will do more housework in the future. Self-driving cars will probably become normal. Prices are falling, so more people are going to buy electric cars.
scenes.say_uz: Menimcha, kelajakda robotlar uy ishlarini ko‘proq bajaradi. O‘zi haydaydigan avtomobillar, ehtimol, oddiy holga keladi. Narxlar tushyapti, shuning uchun ko‘proq odamlar elektr avtomobil sotib oladi.

scenes.title: Ehtimollik: might, could va kelajak so‘zlari
board: will be able to + verb (can emas!)
artificial intelligence · virtual reality · drones · robots

examples.t: We might travel in space one day.
examples.uz: Biz bir kun kelib kosmosda sayohat qilishimiz mumkin.

examples.t: We will be able to talk to computers naturally.
examples.uz: Biz kompyuterlar bilan tabiiy gaplasha olamiz.

scenes.say_native: Ishonchimiz past bo‘lsa, “might”, “may” yoki “could” ishlatiladi: “We might travel in space one day”. Kelajakda qila olish uchun “will be able to” deymiz, chunki “will can” bo‘lmaydi. Kelajak texnologiyalari: “artificial intelligence” — sun’iy intellekt, “virtual reality” — virtual voqelik, “drone”
scenes.say: In the future, we might live with robots, and we'll be able to talk to computers naturally. Drones could deliver our shopping, and virtual reality may change how we learn.
scenes.say_uz: Kelajakda biz robotlar bilan yashashimiz mumkin va kompyuterlar bilan tabiiy gaplasha olamiz. Dronlar xaridlarimizni yetkazishi mumkin va virtual voqelik o‘qish usulimizni o‘zgartirishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Kelajak zamon xatolari
board: ✗ People will can work from home. → ✓ will be able to
✗ I will to buy a new phone. → ✓ I will buy
✗ If it will rain, … → ✓ If it rains, …
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: “will can”. “Can” dan keyin “will” kelmaydi; o‘rniga “will be able to”. Ikkinchisi: “will to buy”. “Will” dan keyin “to” siz fe’l keladi: “I will buy”. Uchinchisi: “If it will rain”. “If” dan keyin kelajak ma’nosida ham hozirgi oddiy zamon ishlatiladi: “If it rains, we will stay at home”.
scenes.say: Don't say will can. Say will be able to. Don't say will to buy. Say will buy. And after if, use the present: If it rains, we will stay at home.
scenes.say_uz: Will can demang. Will be able to deng. Will to buy demang. Will buy deng. Va if dan keyin hozirgi zamonni ishlating: yomg‘ir yog‘sa, uyda qolamiz.

scenes.title: Kelajakni bashorat qiling
board: 2) We (can) live on Mars → will be able to
3) Look at the screen! The battery is almost empty. It ___ die.
4) If robots (do) the housework, we ___ have more free time.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap. Birinchisi: 2050-yilda odamlar mashina haydamaydi, deb ayting, “won’t” bilan. Ikkinchisi: “can” ni kelajakda qanday aytasiz? Uchinchisi: ekranga qarang, batareya deyarli bo‘sh, shuning uchun bu yerda “going to” kerak. To‘rtinchisi: agar robotlar uy ishlarini qilsa, erkin vaqt ko‘proq bo‘ladi. Har birini baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Number one: in twenty fifty, people what drive cars? Number two: we what live on Mars? Number three: the battery is almost empty, so it what die? Number four: if robots do the housework, we what have more free time?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: 2050-yilda odamlar mashina haydamaydimi? Ikkinchi: biz Marsda yashay olamizmi? Uchinchi: batareya deyarli bo‘sh, shuning uchun u nima qiladi? To‘rtinchi: robotlar uy ishlarini qilsa, bizda erkin vaqt ko‘proq bo‘ladimi?

scenes.title: Kelajak javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “people won’t drive cars”. Ikkinchi: “We will be able to live on Mars”. Uchinchi: “It’s going to die”, chunki hozirgi dalil bor, ya’ni batareya deyarli bo‘sh. To‘rtinchi: “If robots do the housework, we will have more free time”, shart qismida hozirgi oddiy zamon, natija qismida “will”.
scenes.say: One: won't drive. Two: will be able to live. Three: is going to die. Four: will have.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: won't drive. Ikki: will be able to live. Uch: is going to die. To‘rt: will have.

scenes.title: Qiyoslash: tezroq, eng foydali
board: more reliable than · less expensive than
the most useful · the best · the worst

examples.t: Fibre internet is faster than ADSL.
examples.uz: Optik tolali internet ADSL dan tezroq.

examples.t: This is the most useful app I have.
examples.uz: Bu menda bor eng foydali ilova.

scenes.say_native: Texnologiyani solishtirish uchun qiyosiy va orttirma daraja kerak. Qisqa sifatlarga “-er” qo‘shiladi: “faster than”, “cheaper than”. Uzun sifatlar bilan “more”: “more reliable than”, “more expensive than”. Orttirma darajada “the” bilan: “the most useful”, “the best”, “the worst”. Yaxshi — “good — better — the best”.
scenes.say: My new phone is faster than my old one, but it's more expensive. It's not as heavy as my laptop. For me, the camera is the most useful feature.
scenes.say_uz: Yangi telefonim eskisidan tezroq, lekin qimmatroq. U noutbukimdek og‘ir emas. Men uchun kamera eng foydali xususiyat.

scenes.title: Qurilmalarni solishtiring
scenes.say_native: Uchta gap tuzing. Birinchisi: noutbuk va planshetni tezlik bo‘yicha solishtiring, “faster than” ishlating. Ikkinchisi: telefon va soatni narxi bo‘yicha solishtiring, “more expensive than” deng. Uchinchisi: kamerangiz haqida “eng yaxshi” ma’nosida gap tuzing, “the best” bilan. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Compare a laptop and a tablet for speed. Compare a phone and a watch for price. Say what the best feature of your phone is.
scenes.say_uz: Noutbuk va planshetni tezlik bo‘yicha solishtiring. Telefon va soatni narx bo‘yicha solishtiring. Telefoningizning eng yaxshi xususiyatini ayting.

scenes.title: Solishtirish javoblari
board: 1) A laptop is faster than a tablet.
2) A phone is more expensive than a watch.
3) The camera is the best feature.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. “A laptop is faster than a tablet”, “A phone is more expensive than a watch”, “The camera is the best feature of my phone”. Qisqa sifat “fast” ga “-er”, uzun “expensive” ga “more”, “good” esa maxsus shakl “best” bo‘ladi. Sizning javobingiz boshqa qurilmalar haqida bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi tuzilma to‘g‘ri bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: A laptop is faster than a tablet. A phone is more expensive than a watch. The camera is the best feature.
scenes.say_uz: Noutbuk planshetdan tezroq. Telefon soatdan qimmatroq. Kamera eng yaxshi xususiyat.

scenes.title: Bir daqiqalik nutq
board: Talk for one minute: a device you cannot live without
1) What is it? What is it used for?
3) How would your life be without it?
scenes.say_native: Endi asosiy vazifa: bir daqiqa gapiring. Eng kerak deb bilgan qurilmangiz haqida ayting. Birinchi, u nima va nima uchun ishlatiladi: “It’s used for…”. Ikkinchi, ikkita afzallik va bitta kamchilik: “On the one hand… however…”. Uchinchi, usiz hayot qanday bo‘lardi. Qolipni eslang: “I can’t live without my… because…”. Boshlang!
scenes.say: Now it's your turn. Talk for one minute about a device you can't live without. Say what it is, what it's used for, its advantages and one disadvantage.
scenes.say_uz: Endi navbat sizda. Bir daqiqa sizsiz yasholmaydigan qurilma haqida gapiring. Uning nima ekanini, nima uchun ishlatilishini, afzalliklarini va bitta kamchiligini ayting.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: It's used for … · It works by …
scenes.say_native: Namuna javobni tinglang. Unda siz o‘rgangan qoliplar bor: “can’t live without”, “used for”, “works by”, “on the one hand” va “however”. O‘zingiznikini tarkibiga qarab tekshiring: qurilma nomi, vazifasi, bitta afzallik, bitta kamchilik va xulosa bormi? Agar bo‘lsa, javobingiz mukammal. Yo‘q bo‘lsa, yana bir marta ayting va yetishmayotgan qismni qo‘shing.
scenes.say: I can't live without my smartphone. It's used for calls, messages and navigation, and it works by connecting to the internet. On the one hand, it saves me time.
scenes.say_uz: Men smartfonimsiz yashay olmayman. U qo‘ng‘iroqlar, xabarlar va yo‘nalish topish uchun ishlatiladi va internetga ulanish orqali ishlaydi. Bir tomondan, u menga vaqt tejaydi.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: devices · apps · turn on / plug in / log in
pros and cons: depend on · addicted to · although
used for · works by · a thing that
will · going to · might · will be able to
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Qurilmalar va internet lug‘atini, “turn it on” kabi frazali fe’llarni o‘rgandik. Afzallik va kamchiliklar uchun “allows us to”, “depend on”, “addicted to”, “on the one hand” va “although” ni ishlatdik. Narsa qanday ishlashini “works by” va “used for” bilan tushuntirdik, nomini bilmasak “a thing that” dedik. Kelajak uchun “will”, “going to”, “might” va “will be able to” ni o‘rgandik, “will can” xatosidan qochdik.
scenes.say: Great job! You can now talk about devices, discuss advantages and disadvantages, explain how something works and predict the future of technology.
scenes.say_uz: Ajoyib! Endi qurilmalar haqida gapira olasiz, afzallik va kamchiliklarni muhokama qilasiz, narsa qanday ishlashini tushuntirasiz va texnologiya kelajagini bashorat qilasiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Speak for 1 minute: a device you cannot live without
used for + works by + 1 advantage + 1 disadvantage
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Siz yashay olmaydigan qurilma haqida bir daqiqa gapiring va o‘zingizni telefonga yozib oling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: qurilma nima uchun ishlatilishini “used for” bilan, qanday ishlashini “works by” bilan aytish, kamida bitta afzallik va bitta kamchilik hamda “depend on” yoki “addicted to” ni to‘g‘ri predlog bilan ishlatish. Yozuvni tinglab, to‘xtab qolgan joylaringizni belgilang. Keyingi darsda sog‘lom turmush tarzi haqida gaplashamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to speak for one minute about a device you cannot live without. Say what it's used for, how it works, and give an advantage and a disadvantage. See you next time!
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifangiz: sizsiz yasholmaydigan qurilma haqida bir daqiqa gapiring. Nima uchun ishlatilishini, qanday ishlashini ayting va bitta afzallik hamda bitta kamchilik keltiring. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishguncha!

homework_uz: Sizsiz yashay olmaydigan qurilma haqida 1 daqiqa gapiring va o‘zingizni yozib oling. Mezon: qurilma nima uchun ishlatilishi (used for), qanday ishlashi (works by), kamida 1 ta afzallik va 1 ta kamchilik hamda depend on / addicted to to‘g‘ri predlog bilan.

options: Turn on it the TV, please.
quiz.why_uz: Televizorni yoqish — “turn on”. O‘zbekcha “ochmoq” ta’sirida “open” deyish xato.
Frazali fe’lda olmosh o‘rtada turadi: “turn it on”.

quiz.q: Many teenagers are addicted ___ their phones.

options: Although it's cheap, but it's slow.
Although but it's cheap, it's slow.
Although it's cheap, however it's slow.

quiz.why_uz: “Is used for” va “-ing” — vazifani bildiradi. “Serves for” ruscha tarjima.

quiz.q: I forgot the word. It's a thing ___ you use to charge your phone.
quiz.why_uz: Narsalarga nisbatan “that” yoki “which” ishlatiladi, “who” esa odamlarga.

quiz.q: In the future, people ___ work from home more.
quiz.why_uz: “Will can” bo‘lmaydi; “will be able to” deymiz.

quiz.q: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
quiz.why_uz: Shart gapida “if” dan keyin hozirgi oddiy zamon ishlatiladi.
